marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Hardware Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology leaders reported robust cloud sector revenue growth alongside updated forward guidance indicating elevated capital expenditure on AI infrastructure through late 2026.
marketLayer.inference: High capital expenditure reinforces long-term demand for semiconductor equipment and server component providers, supporting broader US tech valuations despite short-term margin compression concerns.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization speed of enterprise AI software applications and potential supply chain bottlenecks in advanced packaging.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech Equities & Southbound Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index recorded steady gains during afternoon trading, underpinned by persistent net purchases from Mainland Chinese institutional investors through the Southbound Stock Connect.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained Southbound liquidity serves as a stabilizing floor for Hong Kong platform economy stocks against external macroeconomic turbulence and foreign portfolio reallocation.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Shifts in global risk sentiment and potential changes in domestic regulatory compliance expectations for platform operators.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Monetary Policy Outlook
marketLayer.fact: Recent US macroeconomic data indicated further cooling in core inflation metrics, driving benchmark 10-year US Treasury yields lower across Asian trading hours.
marketLayer.inference: Easing rate expectations lower discount rates for growth-oriented equities, enhancing the relative attractiveness of high-duration tech and consumer discretionary assets across both HK and US markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Unexpected resilience in US labor market data or unexpected commodity price fluctuations delaying policy easing timelines.
